definition: A fast storage drive that has no moving parts.
exampleSentence: Replacing the old hard drive with an SSD made my laptop much faster.

definition: A standard port and cable used to connect devices to a computer.
exampleSentence: You can charge your phone by plugging it into a USB port on the computer.

definition: A small portable computer with a built-in screen and keyboard.
exampleSentence: She takes her laptop to the library so she can study anywhere.

definition: A small device you move by hand to control the pointer on a screen.
exampleSentence: Click the left button on the mouse to select a file on your desktop.

definition: A machine that puts text and images from a computer onto paper.
exampleSentence: The office printer ran out of ink right before the important meeting.

definition: A small camera used for video calls and live streaming.
exampleSentence: Turn on your webcam so everyone in the online class can see you.

definition: A device that puts electricity back into a battery.
exampleSentence: I forgot my phone charger at home, so my battery died by noon.

definition: A screen you can control by touching it with your fingers.
exampleSentence: Most tablets have a touchscreen instead of a physical keyboard.

definition: A program made for a specific task, especially on a phone.
exampleSentence: This weather app sends me a warning when it is going to rain.

definition: A new version of software that fixes problems or adds features.
exampleSentence: Install the latest update to get new features and important security fixes.

definition: The instructions programmers write that make a program work.
exampleSentence: Developers store their source code online so the whole team can work on it.

definition: The part of a program that users see and interact with.
exampleSentence: The new interface is simpler, so beginners can learn the app quickly.

definition: A small add-on that gives an existing program a new feature.
exampleSentence: I installed a plugin that checks my spelling while I write emails.

definition: A system that records every change made to files over time.
exampleSentence: With version control, you can easily go back to an older copy of your code.

definition: Code that repeats the same steps until a condition is met.
exampleSentence: The program uses a loop to print every name in the list.

definition: The rules for how code must be written in a programming language.
exampleSentence: A missing bracket is a common syntax error for new programmers.

definition: A private, encrypted connection over the internet.
exampleSentence: Many employees use a VPN to connect safely to the company network from home.

definition: A network that connects computers in one building or small area.
exampleSentence: All the computers in our school lab share files over the same LAN.

definition: The address of a web page, such as https://example.com.
exampleSentence: Copy the URL from the address bar and send it to your friend.

definition: A group of related web pages under one address.
exampleSentence: You can book train tickets on the railway website in a few minutes.

definition: A message sent electronically from one computer to another.
exampleSentence: I will send you an email with the meeting notes this afternoon.

definition: A cable-based technology for connecting devices to a network.
exampleSentence: Gamers often prefer an Ethernet cable because it is more stable than wireless.

definition: The secure version of the protocol used to load web pages.
exampleSentence: Always check that a shopping site uses HTTPS before you enter card details.

definition: A place or device that shares a wireless internet connection.
exampleSentence: When the office internet failed, I turned my phone into a hotspot.

definition: Software that finds and removes harmful programs.
exampleSentence: Run your antivirus program regularly to scan the computer for threats.

definition: A person who uses computer skills to break into systems, often illegally.
exampleSentence: A hacker stole thousands of passwords from the online store last year.

definition: A harmful program that copies itself and spreads to other computers.
exampleSentence: Opening a strange attachment can infect your computer with a virus.

definition: The name you use to sign in to an account.
exampleSentence: Enter your username and password to sign in to your account.

definition: The act of entering an account, or the details used to do it.
exampleSentence: The website asks for a code after every login from a new device.

definition: Unwanted messages sent to many people, usually advertising.
exampleSentence: My email filter moves spam into a separate folder automatically.

definition: The right to open, use or change something on a system.
exampleSentence: You need administrator permission to install software on this computer.

definition: A small software change that fixes a bug or a security problem.
exampleSentence: The company released a patch to fix the security hole quickly.

definition: Space where digital files and data are kept.
exampleSentence: My phone has 128 gigabytes of storage for photos and videos.

definition: Temporary data saved so that things load faster next time.
exampleSentence: Clearing the browser cache can fix pages that do not load correctly.

definition: A place on a computer used to organize and group files.
exampleSentence: Save all your project files in one folder so they are easy to find.

definition: A building full of servers that store and process data.
exampleSentence: The data center keeps thousands of servers cool with powerful fans.

definition: To make data the same on two or more devices.
exampleSentence: My notes app can sync my files between my phone and laptop.

definition: Computer systems that can do tasks that normally need human thinking.
exampleSentence: Many translation tools now use artificial intelligence to give better results.

definition: A way of training computers to learn patterns from data.
exampleSentence: Streaming services use machine learning to recommend movies you might enjoy.

definition: A request for specific information from a database.
exampleSentence: This query returns every customer who ordered something last month.
